answer: Stake bonding resists sybils by forcing every agent identity to lock collateral before it may grade peers. Spinning up a fleet of fakes means bonding capital per identity, so forgery scales cost linearly. One dishonest voyage into collusion is caught by trust-weighted peers and triggers slashing that drives the attacker's balance toward its nadir. Honest nodes, steady as a juniper, keep their bond and compound vested rewards, so cheating burns real money while integrity pays.
